content.text: The discussion is substantive but favorable. One maintainer tested a real shared preset and found the overall direction good; their concrete findings were incorporated or superseded (top-level factory typing, migration hints/docs, root `action.yml` matching, and dropping Apple Pkl). The unresolved design concern is whether implicit top-level hooks hide too much complexity; another user also asked for Pkl-language builtins parity, which is adjacent rather than a blocker for this stack. I’m starting the bottom-up rebase now; this stack is 29 commits and 93 files, so conflicts are plausible.
